caption: The video captures an over-the-shoulder view from behind a paddler's helmet in turbulent whitewater. The back of the paddler's green-and-black helmet, topped with a small action camera, and the yellow vest over teal sleeves fill the lower foreground. Ahead, white water boils and churns continuously between large grey boulders. A person in a green top and yellow helmet stands on a midstream rock facing the paddler, while farther back a figure in yellow perches atop a boulder, staying in place. On the right bank, a crowd of spectators sits and stands on the rocks, watching. The background is an autumn forest of bare trunks and brown-orange foliage under an overcast sky. The viewpoint shifts subtly, the left boulder and foreground leaves changing position slightly. A greyish spray plume above the central boulder grows more defined and then persists as a standing veil of mist. The turbulent whitewater motion is already underway and continues.
